segment.text: "marketability_summary": "Michael Phelps, widely regarded as the greatest swimmer and most decorated Olympian in history with 28 medals (23 gold), maintains an extraordinary commercial profile a decade after his retirement from competitive swimming
As of 2026, Phelps holds a strong digital footprint led by 3.78 million Instagram followers and over 2 million X followers, characterized by highly authentic, legacy audience engagement
Phelps has successfully transitioned his narrative from unprecedented athletic dominance to vulnerable, globally recognized advocacy for mental health and water safety
This transition is anchored by his work with the Michael Phelps Foundation and high-profile partnerships with digital therapy platform Talkspace and pharmaceutical giant Pfizer

His commercial portfolio remains elite, featuring long-term renewals with blue-chip brands like Under Armour, Visa, and Omega, demonstrating enduring pricing power and exceptional brand safety despite minor past controversies
While his athletic trajectory is retired and social growth is stable rather than explosive, his cultural relevance surges cyclically during Olympic periods

Ultimately, Phelps represents a rare tier of retired athletes whose legendary status and deeply resonant personal narrative provide long-term, premium marketing viability across global health, wellness, and lifestyle sectors
